structure_type.description: e.g. seawall, bulkhead, revetment, groin, jetty

post_event.description: True if the report assesses damage from a specific event (storm, impact) rather than a routine inspection.

repaired.description: True if the report describes a repaired structure. The score reflects condition after repair.

rating_word_only.description: True if the report gives only a rating word (e.g. 'fair', 'poor') with no described defects.

components.description: Each structural element that applies to this structure type, including ones the report does not cover (recorded as NR).

component.description: e.g. face, toe, piles, tiebacks, armor layer, cap, paving

segment.description: Segment name if the report divides the structure into segments, else null.

page.description: Page number from the <page> tag; null only if the value is NR.

quote.description: Exact text copied from that page; null only if the value is NR.

material_source.description: Page and quote stating the material. Null page and quote if material is NR.

primary_or_secondary.description: Primary: wall face or sheeting, toe and footing, piles, tiebacks and anchors, armor layer. Secondary: cap and coping, railings, paving, fenders, drainage outlets.

observed_condition.description: What the report says about this component, or NR if it does not cover it.

page.description: Page number from the <page> tag; null only if the value is NR.

quote.description: Exact text copied from that page; null only if the value is NR.

condition_source.description: Page and quote for the observed condition. Null page and quote if damage_grade is NR.

damage_grade.description: Grade from the rubric's material table and system indicators. NR if the report does not cover this component or does not say it was inspected.

component_score.description: Score this component alone indicates after applying the rubric's extent rules (1 if no defects or minor). Null when damage_grade is NR.

evidence.description: Verbatim quotes from the report that drive the score.

quote.description: Exact text copied from the report

page.description: Page number from the <page> tag the quote appears on

rubric_criterion.description: The rubric criterion this quote meets

segment_scores.description: Only if the report rates segments separately; otherwise an empty array.

secondary_only.description: True if this segment's score is driven only by secondary components.

score.description: Overall (report-level) score. With separately rated segments, the worst segment unless that segment is secondary-only.

critical.description: Only true when score is 4 and localized failure of a primary element has already occurred or wider failure is likely. Otherwise false.

rationale.description: 2-4 sentences tying the evidence to the rubric and explaining why not the adjacent scores. Mention repairs and post-event status where relevant.

alternative_score.description: The next most plausible score, or null if there is none. Required when two scores are equally supported (then choose the more severe as score).

missing_information.description: Information the rubric needs that the report does not provide (e.g. no underwater inspection of the toe).

urgent_safety_concern.description: True if the report recommends closure, load restrictions or emergency repair, regardless of score.

construction_year.description: Year of construction as stated in the report.

value.description: Four-digit year, or NR if the report does not state it. Do not infer.

page.description: Page number from the <page> tag; null only if the value is NR.

quote.description: Exact text copied from that page; null only if the value is NR.

inspection_date.description: Inspection date as stated in the report.

value.description: YYYY-MM-DD (or YYYY-MM / YYYY if only partial), or NR if not stated.

page.description: Page number from the <page> tag; null only if the value is NR.

quote.description: Exact text copied from that page; null only if the value is NR.

exposure_environment.description: Exposure and environment as stated in the report.

value.description: Exposure and environment as the report describes them (wave exposure, tidal range, salt or brackish water, storm history), or NR. Do not infer.

page.description: Page number from the <page> tag; null only if the value is NR.

quote.description: Exact text copied from that page; null only if the value is NR.
